definitions: A kitchen facility that is used by multiple individuals or groups, often found in co-living spaces, hostels, or communal accommodations.
A culinary space designed for collective use, where residents or guests can prepare their own meals independently.
examples: The hostel offers a clean shared kitchen for all guests.
Many students prefer accommodation with a shared kitchen to save on food costs.
Our co-working space includes a shared kitchen with complimentary tea and coffee.
